rows.contract: The old platform setup accepts a valid presentation handle or headless operation.
rows.native_mapping: Capture tagged retained native layer on AppKit main and report explicit detached headless state. Reject invalid object, preserve attached resources, use no Vulkan backend protocol.
rows.expected_result: Test headless, attached pre-window, invalid handle, adopted layer and explicit detach.
rows.actual_result: Native arm64 ARC and production AppKit target linkage, host real AppKit adoption/resize/restore and queued destruction, neutral dependency closure, PICA 48 cases / 801 assertions and CTest 64 passes with 5 existing skips.

rows.contract: Mac surface uses CAMetalLayer supplied by the frontend.
rows.native_mapping: Reuse an existing CAMetalLayer or install a new Cocoa-owned layer on current NSView. Keep same ownership identity across repeated attach and capture. Restore previous view state after detach.
rows.expected_result: Native live NSView checks including app-supplied earlier CALayer, mask, frame and old retained layer.
rows.actual_result: Native arm64 ARC and production AppKit target linkage, host real AppKit adoption/resize/restore and queued destruction, neutral dependency closure, PICA 48 cases / 801 assertions and CTest 64 passes with 5 existing skips.

rows.contract: Presentation platform and capabilities are independent of device support.
rows.native_mapping: Read physical pixels via AppKit conversion, drawable scale, real display mode refresh, fullscreen and suspension flags. Leave actual native GPU selection and drawable acquisition to device/presentation owners.
rows.expected_result: Odd sizes, 1x/2x, clip invalid boundaries, 30/60/120 Hz and hidden/unhide.
rows.actual_result: Exact remaining verification is recorded in progress.json.

rows.contract: Invalid surface/device selection has an actual distinguishable failure.
rows.native_mapping: Reject off-main mutating operations before touching AppKit. Off-main destructor schedules only bounded detach on main, and uses retained state instead of dangling view pointer.
rows.expected_result: Prove rejecting foreign worker, prove main queued cleanup and caller-supplied same handle moves.
rows.actual_result: Native arm64 ARC and production AppKit target linkage, host real AppKit adoption/resize/restore and queued destruction, neutral dependency closure, PICA 48 cases / 801 assertions and CTest 64 passes with 5 existing skips.
